from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import ast,hashlib,json,re,shlex,subprocess
task=Path("reports/T0008")
freeze=json.loads((task/"review-r1-freeze/audit.json").read_text())
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for p,h in freeze["history_sha256"].items():assert sha(p)==h,p
for p in ("src/kmesh/logic/derivations.py","tests/test_derivations.py"):assert sha(p)==freeze["input_sha256"][p],p
base=json.loads((task/"planning-baseline.json").read_text())
for p,h in base["source_sha256"].items():
    if h is not None:assert sha(p)==h,p
assert len(freeze["runs"])==18
assert all(all(r["integrity"].values()) for r in freeze["runs"])
docs=["README.md","docs/implementation_status.md","docs/handoffs/T0008-ground-derivations.md","reports/T0008/review-r1/review.md"]
links=0
for name in docs:
    p=Path(name);s=p.read_text()
    assert s.endswith("\n") and all(line.rstrip()==line for line in s.splitlines()),name
    for target in re.findall(r"\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)",s):
        if "://" in target or target.startswith("#"):continue
        assert (p.parent/target.split("#",1)[0]).resolve().exists(),(name,target)
        links+=1
for p in (task/"review-r1/probe.py",task/"review-r1/rework_guards.py"):ast.parse(p.read_text())
s=Path(docs[2]).read_text()
assert "- 状态："+chr(96)+"needs_changes"+chr(96) in s
fence=chr(96)*3
rework_bash=re.findall(fence+"bash\n(.*?)"+fence,s,re.S)[-1]
commands=[shlex.split(line) for line in rework_bash.splitlines() if line.strip()]
assert len(commands)==6
for argv in commands:
    assert argv[:2]==[".venv/bin/python","reports/T0008/record_check.py"] and argv[3]=="--"
    assert not (task/argv[2]).exists(),argv[2]
    if "pytest" in argv:
        assert argv[-2:]==["--basetemp",f"reports/T0008/{argv[2]}/pytest-tmp"]
subprocess.run(["git","diff","--check"],check=True)
tracked=set(subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--name-only"],text=True).splitlines())
assert tracked=={"README.md","docs/decisions.md","docs/handoffs/T0007-relation-dag.md","docs/implementation_status.md"},tracked
planning=json.loads((task/"planning-final-check/checks.json").read_text())
for p in ("docs/decisions.md","docs/handoffs/T0007-relation-dag.md"):assert sha(p)==planning["artifact_sha256"][p],p
probes=json.loads((task/"review-r1-probes/findings.json").read_text())
audit={"created_at_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"result":"NEEDS_CHANGES","task_status":"needs_changes","head":freeze["head"],"reviewer":"Codex + gpt-6-astra xhigh; non-author of Pi implementation","test_reviewer":"/root/review_t0008_design; read-only non-author review","reviewed_files":{p:freeze["input_sha256"][p] for p in ("src/kmesh/logic/derivations.py","tests/test_derivations.py")},"product_defect_found":False,"acceptance":{"A1":"PASS in reviewed implementation","A2":"PASS","A3":"PASS","A4":"PASS","A5":"NEEDS_CHANGES","A6":"NEEDS_CHANGES: guard; product imports compliant","A7":"NEEDS_CHANGES"},"findings":[{"id":"R1","priority":"P2","summary":"Order-dependent collection and incomplete subprocess import isolation"},{"id":"R2","priority":"P2","summary":"Two incorrect matching implementations pass the submitted tests; add discriminating fixtures and explicit boundary cases"},{"id":"R3","priority":"P2","summary":"README reverses exact-budget semantics and misstates candidate order"},{"id":"R4","priority":"P2","summary":"Execution record conflicts with immutable RUN evidence; append corrections and disclose move/reuse"}],"verification":{},"oracle":{"worlds":probes["worlds"],"records":probes["records_checked"],"seed":probes["seed"],"result":probes["product_oracle"]},"mutation_results":probes["mutation_results"],"pi_records_checked":18,"historical_files_preserved":len(freeze["history_sha256"]),"strict_local_links_checked":links,"rework_commands_checked":6,"rework_guards_validation":"syntax checked; requires the three new Pi test fixtures before execution","limits":["No product or submitted test changes by Codex","No commit/push","Historical move/reuse actions not independently reconstructed","First isolation subprobe injected after scan; replaced by separate before-scan run, original evidence retained","Direct derivations only; no full-proof, uniqueness or research claim"],"artifact_sha256":{p:sha(p) for p in docs+["reports/T0008/review-r1/probe.py","reports/T0008/review-r1/rework_guards.py"]}}
for run in ("review-r1-freeze","review-r1-full","review-r1-readme-order","review-r1-probes","review-r1-isolation-probe"):
    r=json.loads((task/run/"record.json").read_text())
    assert r["before"]["source_sha256"]==r["after"]["source_sha256"],run
    audit["verification"][run]={k:r[k] for k in ("argv","exit_code","elapsed_s","started_at_utc","finished_at_utc")}
(task/"review-r1/final-audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(audit,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
print(f"PASS: product/test frozen; {len(freeze['history_sha256'])} historical files unchanged; all 18 Pi RUN streams match hashes.")
print(f"PASS: {links} local link targets, six rework commands, helper syntax, mutation scope and diff hygiene.")
print("REVIEW VERDICT: needs_changes (R1-R4); A1-A4 implementation passed, A5-A7 require rework.")
